originalSourceText:
Q.7   Which sequence correctly represents the training cycle?

      (A) Backpropagation → Forward pass → Loss → Update

      (B) Forward pass → Loss calculation → Backpropagation → Gradient descent

      (C) Loss → Forward pass → Gradient descent → Backpropagation

      (D) Forward pass → Gradient descent → Loss → Backpropagation

      Explanation: The learning cycle as prediction through forward propagation, loss
       evaluation, gradient calculation/error propagation through backpropagation,
     and parameter update using gradient descent.

      Refer Slide 21 of Lecture 34: Fundamentals of Neural Networks
